{{Youmay|the rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]]|the [[Prince/Legends|title]] of royalty}}
A '''Prince''' was a rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]], and one with the lowest number of members excepting the [[Old Guard (Black Bha'lir)|Old Guard]] and the [[Tribunal of the Black Bha'lir Society|Tribunal]]. Princes were members who had made a name for themselves, and were well-known within both the Black Bha'lir and the greater criminal underworld.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
